sealed interface S
class A : S
class B : S
fun f(v: S): Int = when(v) { is A -> 1 }

sealed interface S
data object A : S
fun f(): Int = try { 1 } catch (_: Exception) { 2 }

class A:S
class B:S

interface J

protected constructor()
